title: K-cosheaf on the apartment with K-condition
body_html:
$K$-cosheaf on the apartment with $K$-condition

Let $(G', G)$, $S$, $N$, $A$ be as in Reductive pair (G', G) and the apartment A.

Definition. A $K$-cosheaf for $(G', G)$ on $A$ is an $N$-equivariant cosheaf $K$ of compact open subgroups of $G$ on $A$ satisfying the $K$-condition: $$G'_x \;\le\; K_x \cap G' \;\le\; \Fix_{G'}(x) \qquad \text{for all } x \in A.$$

The $K$-condition implies $G'_x \cap N \le K_x \cap N \le \Fix_N(x)$.

The cosheaf $K$ encodes a choice of "thickening" of the parahorics $G'_x$ inside $G$; the resulting generalized building Generalized building B(Σ) = G ×^K A is to $K$ what the Bruhat–Tits building is to $G'$.

Examples

  • $K_x := G'_x$ recovers the Bruhat–Tits building of $G'$ as a special case.
  • For $G$ classical and $G' = G^{(0)}$ a centralizer in a semisimple type, the Stevens groups $J^\circ(\beta, \Lambda_x)$ give $K_x$ (see [[node:applications.classical_K1_K2_K3]]).
  • For tame types, the Kim–Yu–AFMO construction supplies $K_x$ as the product $G^{(0)}_{x,0} J_x$ (see [[node:applications.tame_K_F_construction]]).
